description: A bare true key names an object type attribute true
notes: The README requires attribute names to be valid identifiers, which true is, and builds the extension on hcl.ExprAsKeyword and hcl.ExprCall. The native syntax spec makes a keyword's role supersede other readings, but also says true can be interpreted as a static traversal named true (hclsyntax/spec.md#static-traversal), which gives the name true, while hcl.ExprAsKeyword's own documentation (traversal_for_expr.go) says the native syntax parses true, false and null as literal values, so they can't be keywords. hashicorp/hcl names the attribute true: ObjectConsKeyExpr.AsTraversal passes the key to LiteralValueExpr.AsTraversal, which turns the literal back into its name (hclsyntax/expression.go).
